text: Given a valid X-Figma-Token, figma_get_me returns the authenticated user's id, email and handle.
steps: Set X-Figma-Token to a valid Figma personal access token
Call figma_get_me with no arguments
expect: Result is a JSON object with id, email and handle fields matching the token owner's Figma account.

text: Any tool call without X-Figma-Token returns HTTP 401 with required_headers listing X-Figma-Token.
figma_get_file on a known file key returns the document node tree; an ids filter scopes the tree to those nodes.
steps: Call figma_get_file with a known file_key and no ids
Call figma_get_file again with the same file_key and ids set to one node id from the first result
expect: First call returns a full document tree. Second call returns a tree containing only the requested node id and its subtree.

text: figma_get_file_nodes with specific ids returns only those nodes, not the rest of the file.
steps: Call figma_get_file_nodes with file_key and ids set to 2 known node ids
expect: Result's nodes map has exactly those 2 ids as keys, each with its own subtree.

text: figma_get_file_meta returns name/thumbnail_url/last_modified without the node tree.
steps: Call figma_get_file_meta with a known file_key
expect: Result includes name, thumbnail_url and last_modified; result does not include a document key.

text: figma_render_images with format svg returns a non-null image URL per requested node id.
steps: Call figma_render_images with file_key, ids set to 1 known node id, format='svg'
expect: Result's images map has that node id with a non-null URL.

text: figma_list_image_fills on a file with at least one embedded image returns a non-empty images map.
steps: Call figma_list_image_fills with a file_key known to contain an embedded image fill
expect: Result's images map is non-empty, keyed by image reference with a download URL value.

text: figma_list_file_versions returns a versions page plus prev_page/next_page cursors; paging with the cursor advances to the next page.
steps: Call figma_list_file_versions with a file_key that has more than one page of version history
Call figma_list_file_versions again with cursor set to the first call's next_page value
expect: First call returns a versions list and a non-null next_page. Second call returns a different set of versions than the first.

text: figma_list_folders(team_id=...) returns that team's top-level folders.
steps: Call figma_list_folders with team_id set to a known team id
expect: Result's folders list includes the known top-level folders of that team.

text: figma_list_folders(folder_id=...) returns that folder's direct subfolders.
steps: Call figma_list_folders with folder_id set to a known folder id that has subfolders
expect: Result's folders list includes the known subfolders of that folder.

text: figma_list_folders called with both team_id and folder_id, or with neither, returns invalid_argument and makes no upstream call.
figma_list_folder_files(folder_id=...) returns the files directly inside that folder.
steps: Call figma_list_folder_files with folder_id set to a known folder id containing at least one file
expect: Result's files list includes the known file(s) in that folder.

text: figma_list_comments on a file with existing comments returns them with author/message/timestamp.
steps: Call figma_list_comments with a file_key known to have at least one comment
expect: Result's comments list includes the known comment(s) with author, message and timestamp fields.

text: figma_create_comment posts a new top-level comment, and a threaded reply when comment_id is given.
steps: Call figma_create_comment with file_key and a test message, no comment_id
Call figma_create_comment again with the same file_key, a new message, and comment_id set to the id returned by the first call
expect: First call returns a new top-level comment object. Second call returns a reply comment linked to the first comment's id.

text: figma_delete_comment without confirm:true does not delete the comment.
steps: Create a test comment via figma_create_comment
Call figma_delete_comment with that comment's id and confirm omitted (or false)
Call figma_list_comments and check the comment is still present
expect: figma_delete_comment returns a not-done result; the comment still appears in figma_list_comments afterward.

text: figma_delete_comment with confirm:true permanently deletes the comment.
steps: Create a test comment via figma_create_comment
Call figma_delete_comment with that comment's id and confirm:true
Call figma_list_comments and check the comment is gone
expect: figma_delete_comment returns {done:true, deleted_comment_id}; the comment no longer appears in figma_list_comments.

text: Status-to-error-code mapping: 400/403/404/429/5xx/network-timeout each map to the documented envelope code and retryable flag, and none raise past run_tool.
A real call against a deliberately invalid file key returns not_found via the structured error envelope, not an exception.
steps: Call figma_get_file with file_key set to a syntactically valid but non-existent file key
expect: Tool call returns {"error":{"code":"not_found",...}} as its string result; no exception propagates.

text: A mocked oversized figma_list_comments response (>20000 chars serialized) is returned truncated with has_more/truncated fields rather than erroring or silently dropping records.
repr(FigmaCredentials(...)) and every logged error path redact the raw token value.
Two concurrent simulated requests carrying different X-Figma-Token values each see only their own credential inside the tool body (contextvars isolation).
